name: Firewatch Fold V3
transformation: Tower of Logic supplies the two faces, eye inspection, edge crossings, arrow movement, direction-dependent extinguishing and one-use stock. V3 adds circulating fire cores, ballistic water, thermal ladder locks and seeded changing currents. The source Master matching-color rule becomes first-contact canister planning among independently moving cores. Both gutter faces remain simultaneously visible; the source eye control highlights a face while the moving context stays available.
assets: Original canvas artwork and code. No source artwork or third-party implementation copied.
construction_revision_notes: After initial-map schedule diagnostics, all profiles use independently smooth-changing 3-second currents; D1/D2 retain two colored crossing fronts with forgiving geometry. Dual-face visibility corrects the prior hidden-face recent-window evidence gap. Colored trails preserve identity through motion. World and collision parameters are unchanged.
